_comment: Every app-grade portrait in public/heads/hd/, one row per file, built by scripts/heads/normalize-heads.py. 'out' is the file stem; a legacy /heads/<stem>.webp maps to /heads/hd/<stem>.webp in the feed. 'identity' records how the master was tied to the face already published under that name: ncc = image correlation of the master against the live file (0.9 or above), bank-row or squad-table = the named record in fifa.archv/player-headshot-bank.md; reference-render = a GPT Image 2 portrait rendered 2026-09-11 on the founder's prompt, verbatim, from the reference photo named in 'reference' (job id in 'job'), likeness checked by eye against that photo. A name with no verified master is left out on purpose, and its entries keep the crest in the app. 'frame': 'none' marks a master with no baked frame to trim. 'marks' lists boxes, in master pixels, of logos, crests, sponsor marks and text that normalize-heads.py paints out before fitting (canon D90); the CDN master is never edited. bank-local sources live in fifa.archv/assets/headshots (pass --masters).

identity.note: GPT Image 2 render, 2026-09-11, founder prompt verbatim, from this reference photo (official club photo). Likeness checked by eye against the reference.

Entries using /heads/santos.webp name Andrey Santos in imageAlt, but that file is the June text-only generation (bank row 182, no photo reference). Rebuilt from the verified regen (bank row 183, genuine photo ref, founder QC approved 2026-07-10), the same master andrey-santos uses.
Serves /heads/vozinha.webp too: that file is a bracketed card crop of an earlier Vozinha cover (0.70 against its own master), so the clean registry master replaces it.
